What your risk factor means
If a breast cancer assessment shows that you have higher risk factors for developing cancer, don’t be alarmed. Those results only mean that you’ll need to be vigilant against the disease. Schedule an appointment with one of our doctors today, to detect any cancer early, when it’s easier to treat.
